cohort: 7533 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who delivered babies at a Chinese hospital between July 2017 and June 2020
finding: Women with GDM complicated with preeclampsia were at higher risks of fetal malformations, fetal growth restriction, cesarean section, emergency cesarean section, preterm birth, low birth weight, small for gestational age and neonatal hypoglycemia.
birth_weight: LBW (low birth weight) babies were included in the study, but no specific weight range was mentioned
